planSteps.description: In a fresh browser session, navigate to https://loopledger-s4-git-feat-season4-b35ea5-jerrys-projects-82705168.vercel.app and verify that this exact hostname is still in the address bar. Stay on this branch preview throughout the test. Do not navigate to the older loopledger-s4.vercel.app production site, even if old captured pages reference it.
Enter https://github.com/TestSprite/testsprite-cli/pull/218 and click Inspect PR. Wait for the PR title and head SHA.

Activate the native download link with the accessible name and title "Download evidence report" (the downward-arrow icon next to Refresh evidence). The link has a download attribute naming PR-218-evidence.md. This is a separate link, not the Report tab. Wait for the browser download triggered by this activation.

Verify the browser actually downloaded a file named PR-218-evidence.md, and read that file. Its Markdown must contain https://github.com/TestSprite/testsprite-cli/pull/218, the full head SHA 79054cff490203c7ae4b6bb3ca4f737734cabd9e, and a Scope section. Displaying the report in the page alone is not a pass.
